s.how: Cut 500g white fish fillets into strips. Dip in 50g flour, 2 beaten eggs and 120g panko, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon and chopped dill and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: the forge where Hiccup works for Gobber
s.how: Cook 600g thick smoked sausages over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and split. Cut into chunks and serve on a board with 4 tbsp wholegrain mustard for dipping.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder, then add 1 onion, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in chunks, 100g pearl barley, thyme and 1.25L beef stock. Cover and simmer 2 hours until the lamb is tender and the barley is plump. Serve in big bowls with bread.

w.note: a sweet for the dragon riders
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g honey, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp cinnamon and 80ml milk. Spoon into 12 muffin cases and bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Brush with 2 tbsp warm honey while hot.

d.note: something for a cold day on Berk
d.how: Blend 300g frozen mixed berries with 1L apple juice for a full minute until completely smooth. Strain through a fine sieve, pressing on the pulp, then chill and serve in 4 glasses over ice.
